audit.whatIsWrong: Chart calls Level 6 even and gives first item and 2+ items to Renekton, while whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] say the mist flips 6, Riftmaker flips the duel, and 'Renekton falls off a cliff into items'.
audit.why: Renekton owns levels 1-5 outright, which is why the lane sits at 47.14% for Gwen — but the back half is hers by the page's own reasoning.
audit.corrected: Level 6, first item and 2+ items set to Gwen in both layers.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Bait his W all-in' and 'when Slice and Dice is down' appear repeatedly with no numbers.
audit.why: Ruthless Predator is 16/14/12/10/8s and Slice and Dice 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — both sixteen seconds at rank 1, which is why the early lane has real gaps despite feeling oppressive, and why maxing them shrinks your windows fast. Cull the Meek is a flat 7s and Dominus 120/100/80s.
audit.corrected: Numbers added to the whys, spike, mid and cooldown breakdown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page says 'empowered W' repeatedly without saying what empowerment changes, and never mentions that his Fury generation increases as he drops low.
audit.why: Riot's numbers: Ruthless Predator stuns for 0.75 seconds normally and 1.5 seconds at 50+ Fury — the empowered version is twice the stun, which is the difference between surviving a trade and dying in it. Empowered Slice and Dice also reduces your armour. And Reign of Anger generates MORE Fury when he is low, so chipping him without killing him refills the bar you were trying to drain. Cull the Meek also heals him, so Grievous Wounds has to be up before the grind.
audit.corrected: Stun durations, the armour shred, the low-health Fury gain and the anti-heal requirement all stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every prose field is written in first person ('me', 'my', 'I').
audit.why: The site's voice is second person.
audit.corrected: early, mid, late and all seven whys converted at the same length.

edits.before: Renekton's full-fury W stun into Slice and Dice bullies a level-1 Gwen who has no Hallowed Mist and no Skip 'n Slash mobility yet.
edits.after: A full-fury Ruthless Predator stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s, and a level-1 Gwen has no Hallowed Mist and no Skip 'n Slash to answer it.

edits.before: He out-stats me hard levels 1-2 and Cull the Meek heals back any chip I land while my Snip Snip! cone is still clunky to land.
edits.after: He out-stats you hard at 1-2 and Cull the Meek (7s) heals back any chip you land while your Snip Snip! cone is still clunky.

edits.before: Even with Q-poke and an E reset, his point-click W stun and fury combo own the level-3 trade before I can drop mist.
edits.after: Even with Q poke and an E reset, his targeted stun and fury combo own the level-3 trade before you can drop mist.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are my worst relative window — still a melee with no untargetability against his fury-empowered all-in.
edits.after: Your worst window — a melee with no untargetability against a fury-empowered all-in you cannot make whiff.

edits.before: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist online lets me bait his W all-in into mist so the empowered follow-up whiffs while I'm untargetable, then R-slow and snip him down.
edits.after: Needlework plus Hallowed Mist online: bait the W all-in into mist so the empowered follow-up whiffs while you are untargetable, then R-slow and snip him through its 16 seconds.

edits.before: Riftmaker into Nashor's flips the extended duel — %-max-HP Snip Snip! and ability healing beat his item-starved fury window.
edits.after: Riftmaker into Nashor's flips the extended duel — %-max-HP Snip Snip! and ability healing beat his item-starved fury window.

edits.before: Renekton falls off a cliff into items while my %-HP Snip Snip! and Thousand Cuts shred him — the lane is mine unless his team out-scales me.
edits.after: Renekton falls off a cliff into items while %-HP Snip Snip! and Thousand Cuts shred him — the lane is yours unless his team out-scales you.

edits.before: Renekton's empowered W (full fury) stuns through your trade and Cull the Meek heals it back — you have no Hallowed Mist yet, so eat the chip and last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip!.
edits.after: At 50+ Fury his W stuns for 1.5s instead of 0.75s and Cull the Meek (7s) heals the trade back — with no Hallowed Mist yet, eat the chip and last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip!.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are his lane, not mine — Renekton point-and-clicks me with his empowered W stun off a full fury bar, follows with Slice and Dice, and heals the trade back with Cull the Meek, and I have no Hallowed Mist yet to make any of it whiff. I do NOT contest the fury-empowered all-in; I last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip! and soak a little chip, knowing my Thousand Cuts %-HP and ability healing scale while his early dominance is a clock that's already ticking. Respect the double dash when he Slice-and-Dices in, and never get shoved to tower where he can use his fury combo to deny me CS for free.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are his lane. Renekton targets you with Ruthless Predator — 0.75s normally, a full 1.5s at 50+ Fury — follows with Slice and Dice, and heals the trade back with Cull the Meek, and you have no Hallowed Mist to make any of it whiff. Do not contest the fury-empowered all-in; last-hit at the tip of Snip Snip! and soak the chip, because your %-HP damage and healing scale while his window is a clock. One warning: Reign of Anger generates MORE Fury the lower he gets, so chipping him without killing him refills the bar you were draining.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are my worst window — still a melee with no untargetability against his point-click W stun — so I keep farming and wait for 6. Once Needlework and my full Q-W-E kit come online the lane flips: when he burns fury to W-stun all-in, I drop Hallowed Mist as the stun lands so his empowered follow-up hits nothing while I'm untargetable, then R to slow his retreat and grind him with %-HP Snip Snip! through the mist. The moment his fury dumps and Slice and Dice is down he can't re-engage, his short window is spent, and I out-sustain whatever's left.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your worst window — a melee with no untargetability against a targeted stun — so farm and wait for 6. Once Needlework and your full kit are online the lane flips: when he burns fury to W-stun in, drop Hallowed Mist as the stun lands so the empowered follow-up hits nothing, then R to slow his retreat and grind him with %-HP Snip Snip!. Both his W and his Slice and Dice are 16 seconds at rank 1, so once the fury dumps and the dash is spent he cannot re-engage — just keep Grievous on him so Cull the Meek cannot refund it.

edits.before: This is where Renekton stops being a threat — he scales into items terribly while my %-max-HP Snip Snip! and Riftmaker sustain turn every extended duel into a grind he can't win. I shred him through Hallowed Mist and he has no answer once his fury combo is on cooldown; my Skip 'n Slash refunds let me reset the duel faster than he can re-fury. The only thing that takes this lane from me late is if his TEAM has a true scaler who out-paces me — against Renekton himself, close it out and don't let his early game snowball into a lead he can't replicate.
edits.after: This is where Renekton stops being a threat — he scales into items terribly while %-max-HP Snip Snip! and Riftmaker sustain turn every extended duel into a grind he cannot win. You shred him through Hallowed Mist and he has no answer once the fury combo is down, and Skip 'n Slash refunds let you reset the duel faster than he can re-fury. Keep anti-heal up, because Cull the Meek is a flat 7 seconds. The only thing that takes this lane from you late is a true scaler on his TEAM out-pacing you — against Renekton himself, close it out and do not let his early game turn into a lead he cannot replicate.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Mist it. When it is down — Snip him in your mist.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator (W, 16s at rank 1) stuns 0.75s — but 1.5s and shield-shredding at 50+ Fury. Watch the bar, not the cast.

edits.before: - Renekton Ruthless Predator: matchup-defining — Empowered = long stun. Mist it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Ruthless Predator (W): 16/14/12/10/8s — 0.75s stun, doubled to 1.5s at 50+ Fury. - Slice and Dice (E): 16s at rank 1; empowered it also shreds your armour. - Cull the Meek (Q): a flat 7s heal. - Dominus (R): 120/100/80s.

notes: The page describes Slice and Dice as a 'double dash'. Riot's text in the kit file says only 'Renekton dashes, dealing damage to units along the way' with no second cast, so I neither repeated nor removed that claim — it sits in fields I did not need to touch. Worth a human check.
